source: HubSpot CRM (portal 40058686), pulled interactively via Claude connector

filters.open_deals: dealstage NOT IN (Stage 5 - Won, Closed Lost)
filters.closed_deals: dealstage IN (Stage 5 - Won, Closed Lost) AND closedate BETWEEN 2026-04-01 AND 2027-03-31 (FY27)
filters.companies: lifecyclestage = 'customer' OR previous_client_date_added__c IS NOT NULL

notes.companyServiceLines: Derived from open_deals.json + closed_deals.json (same pull, same data horizon) by grouping each company's deals and collecting distinct service_line values -- NOT an all-time history. Most companies became customers via closed-won deals before FY27 (outside this pull's scope), so only 182/744 companies have service-line data here. A true all-time service-line rollup would need a full-portal DEAL query, which hits a 1000-row cap in query_crm_data with no working way to narrow it via cross-object WHERE.
